description: Evaluation set for the manned-spaceflight Q&A agent. Covers factual recall, multi-document synthesis, out-of-scope refusal, ambiguous queries, and multi-turn follow-ups. Designed to stress the RAG pipeline without relying on judge-model memorization.

testCases.description: Single-fact lookup from the Apollo 11 article.

turns.question: Who commanded the Apollo 11 mission?
turns.expectedBehavior: Name Neil Armstrong as the commander and cite the Apollo 11 article.

testCases.description: Date recall for the first Moon landing.

turns.question: On what date did Apollo 11 land on the Moon?
turns.expectedBehavior: State July 20, 1969 and cite the Apollo 11 source.

testCases.description: Role-in-crew lookup across the astronaut + mission articles.

turns.question: What role did Buzz Aldrin have on the Apollo 11 mission?
turns.expectedBehavior: Identify him as Lunar Module Pilot, with a citation.

testCases.description: Early Mercury program — tests non-Apollo factual recall.

turns.question: Who was the first American in space, and on which mission?
turns.expectedBehavior: Name Alan Shepard and Freedom 7 (Mercury-Redstone 3), cited.

testCases.description: Requires joining Armstrong's biography with the Gemini 8 mission article.

turns.question: Which Gemini mission did Neil Armstrong fly before Apollo 11, and who was his crewmate?
turns.expectedBehavior: Answer Gemini 8 with David Scott, drawing from both the Armstrong bio and the Gemini 8 article.

testCases.description: Multi-doc synthesis across Michael Collins and Gemini 10.

turns.question: What was Michael Collins's role on his first spaceflight, and on which mission did he fly it?
turns.expectedBehavior: Identify Collins as Pilot of Gemini 10, drawing from his bio and the Gemini 10 article.

testCases.description: Compare two spacecraft — forces the agent to synthesize across articles.

turns.question: How does the crew capacity of Crew Dragon compare to the Apollo Command Module?
turns.expectedBehavior: State Crew Dragon's capacity (up to 7, typically 4) and Apollo CM (3), citing both spacecraft articles.

testCases.description: Person/role not described in any corpus article — should refuse.

turns.question: Who is the current CEO of SpaceX?
turns.expectedBehavior: Refuse with the 'not in current corpus' guardrail. Do NOT speculate, even though the answer is common knowledge.

testCases.description: Entirely off-topic science question — should refuse cleanly.

turns.question: Can you explain quantum entanglement?
turns.expectedBehavior: Refuse — topic is not in the spaceflight corpus.

testCases.description: 'First mission' is ambiguous (first crewed? first American? first to the Moon?).

turns.question: What was the first mission?
turns.expectedBehavior: Acknowledge the ambiguity (first to orbit, first American, first to the Moon, etc.) and either ask for clarification or cover the most likely interpretations with citations.

testCases.description: Second turn relies on pronoun resolution against first-turn context.

turns.question: Who was the Command Module Pilot on Apollo 11?
turns.expectedBehavior: Name Michael Collins with a citation.

turns.question: Which Gemini mission did he fly before that?
turns.expectedBehavior: Resolve 'he' to Michael Collins and answer Gemini 10 with a citation. Must exercise session memory.

turns.question: When did the Space Shuttle program end?
Which orbiter flew its final flight?
turns.expectedBehavior: Answer Atlantis (STS-135), using context from the prior turn.
